driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car drivers (Saval et al. 2023); maintains high discharge headway to match M1/car (observed 0.3467s) by reducing aggressive acceleration.
Passive car violators drawn from 'car' distribution; p=0 for queue_space_seeking ensures they do not block right-turn lanes, keeping M9a/per_cycle low.
Main compliant motorcycle population; share=0.95 ensures sum with moto_seeker (0.05) equals 1 for 'moto' distribution.
Compliant motorcycle drivers drawn from the 'moto' distribution; share=0.05 ensures sum with moto_saval (0.95) equals 1 for 'moto' distribution.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); share=1.0 is the only member of 'moto_violator', summing to 1.

traci_rules.rationale: Motorcycles have a 50% probability of running the red light when at the stop line; no swarm effect (k=0). Maintains M3/share/moto (observed 0.098) and M4/overshoot_share (observed 0.62).
Sets early-start probability p=0.13 to match M2/early/moto observed share (0.1302), causing motorcycles to creep over the stop line in the last 5s of red.
Activates sidewalk riding (p_sidewalk=0.75) and wrong-lane usage (p_wrong_lane=0.25) to match M10a (0.56 veh/cycle) and M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.249), reducing queue length impacts.
High bypass probability (0.8) allows motorcycles to pass standing U-turners, reducing delay and matching field observations of aggressive maneuvering.
Low bypass probability (0.1) for cars reflects their reluctance to change lanes past U-turners, maintaining realistic car behavior.
